name: Chu Ssu-fa
bio: Chu Ssu-fa (朱嗣發; Zhu Sifa; 13th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 摸鱼儿 (Mo yu er)
poems.author: Chu Ssu-fa
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
对西风、鬓摇烟碧，参差前事流水。
紫丝罗带鸳鸯结，的的镜盟钗誓。
浑不记、漫手织回文，几度欲心碎。
安花著蒂。
奈雨覆云翻，情宽分窄，石上玉簪脆。
朱楼外。
愁压空云欲坠。
月痕犹照无寐。
阴晴也只随天意。
枉了玉消香碎。
君且醉。
君不见、长门青草春风泪。
一时左计。
悔不早荆钗，暮天修竹，头白倚寒翠。
